utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye out by the door for the book club details. And nice, I heard Cleo still has tea and snacks left too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll ask what everyone thinks and let Ira know, and I’ll remind folks to bring their pick for Thursday too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll watch for Uli’s details by the door, and Thursday should be set. Glad Cleo’s got the tea and snacks covered too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa’s helping choose the next book, and Sam can help with the details. I’m still organizing, and Oren’s bringing the cookies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Rosa can check the library copy on Maple Street, and I’ll keep track of the details. Mara, let me know if you need anything else for setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I need anything else for setup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, thanks — I’m still waiting on the book and time, so I’ll keep an eye out for Ira’s update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — once Ira sends the book and time, I’ll help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading back from errands now, and I’ll send Bo the book and the meeting time. It’s at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — I’ll borrow The Midnight Library from Gus and catch up before Thursday at 7 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll send Bo the book and the time as soon as I’m home.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the tea and a few snacks to book club.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, but can you confirm we’re all reading the same book this week?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I think so — I’ll check the book list and make sure we’re all on the same one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules is bringing a couple easy snacks and a discussion question, so that part’s covered. If Rey wants, I can swing by, and then we can compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare copy of "The Midnight Library" if Dane still needs it, and Hana can confirm what mystery novel we’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — that helps a lot. I’ll let Rey know I can swing by, and we can compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and get back to Leo soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — that’d be really helpful. I’m looking forward to book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll check the calendar and let Leo know soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me — I’ll be there with the book ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at Quinn’s place works for me if the invite goes out soon. I’m happy to wait for the time and place confirmation before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll wait for Quinn’s details too, and Thursday at 7 is still the plan on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll bring the cookies to Mara’s book club. Looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — that’s kind of you. I’ll drop the book club details by Noah’s door.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks! I’ll look out for the details and see you at Mara’s book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus said I can borrow his copy when it comes in, so I’m set for now. And Tess can swing by if I want, which is nice.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know — I heard we’re meeting next Thursday at Mara’s place, and Oren’s bringing cookies. I’ll bring a snack if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice — I’ll keep Thursday in mind. Mara’s place with cookies is a pretty good setup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free next Thursday evening, so I can make it to book club.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—Thursday at my place works, and I’ll send everyone the details and a quick invite. Eli and Mina are in too, so it should be a nice group.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye out for the invite.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are we meeting on Thursday, Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but we’re still set for Thursday at the cafe. Opal said she’d keep everyone posted, and I’ll bring a couple of ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks — I’ll watch for Opal’s update. Let me know if the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’ll borrow The Midnight Library and catch up before Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great — I’m looking forward to it. Mara’s organizing the details, and Mina was checking the meeting time with me too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Thursday at 7 works for me too — I’ll read up and be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s still the same book this week, right? Could you double-check the title for me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s the same book this week. I’ll double-check the title and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the title once you’ve checked it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is book club still on Thursday? I’m checking the details for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still on Thursday. I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll let everyone know it’s on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa’s helping pick the next book, and Sam’s available if we need help with the details. I’m organizing things on my end, and Oren’s bringing the cookies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free next Thursday evening for book club. Nell may bring a snack if she can make it, and Faye still needs to check the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, next Thursday evening works for me too. I’ll keep coordinating the details and let Rosa know we’ve got the time set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, right — I heard they’re meeting next Thursday at Mara’s, and we should bring a snack if we can. Oren’s bringing cookies, and Leo’s still waiting on Faye about the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at Quinn’s place works for me if the invite goes out soon — I just want to confirm the time and place first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that’s what I heard too — next Thursday at Mara’s, once Faye confirms the school schedule. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can drop the book club details by Noah’s door, and I’ll let you know the book and time as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that works—just let me know the book and time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will. I’ll leave the details by Noah’s door and tell you as soon as I know the book and time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the book club title first, and then I’ll confirm it for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — once you confirm the title, Kira can pass along the time and place to Pia. Thanks, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the title now, and I’ll confirm it as soon as I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and get back to Leo soon. Quinn can send everyone the details and invite, and Eli’s in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring tea and some snacks if that still helps for book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be lovely, thank you—tea and snacks would be a big help. I’ll confirm the school calendar and let Leo know soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules said they’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question, so that’s one thing handled. If Rey wants, I can swing by—and then Rey and I can compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Tess — thank you. We’re still set for Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll bring a couple of ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Thursday at the cafe works for me. I’m looking forward to it, and I’ll check in with Rey after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll let Bo know the meeting’s at the community center and send the book and time after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that helps. I’ll bring the cookies and see you at Mara’s book club at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Oren — I’ll send Bo the book and time as soon as I’m done with errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send everyone the details and a quick invite for the book club. Eli and Mina are coming, and Thursday at my place works for Pia too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — send it over soon for Thursday at your place. And if Gus’s copy comes in, I can borrow it from him.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the invite and details out soon for Thursday at my place. If Gus’s copy lands, you can absolutely borrow it from him.
